instrument.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
instrument.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)

freshness.note: NIST announces a revision of AI RMF 1.0; none was published when checked.

requirements.locator: GOVERN 1.1, Table 1, printed page 22 / PDF page 27
requirements.interpretation: Link each selected requirement to an identified source version and interpretation revision, retaining who owns the deployment determination outside the core.
requirements.criterion: An institutional origin requires a source reference and locator; an internal origin uses an explicit absence reason. Missing provenance must not be silently completed.
requirements.limits: Presence of references demonstrates metadata completeness only; it does not demonstrate organizational understanding, legal accuracy or management effectiveness.

capability.mechanism: Each policy's binding names its origins, each with a source reference or an explicit reason for its absence; a binding without either is refused.
Decision records keep each policy's declared origins, and explanations show them.

left_to_deployment: Understanding and managing the legal and regulatory requirements.
The accuracy of the declared references.
